title: Less is More: How Degrowth Will Save the World
description: This book explores the problems caused by endless expansion, domination and extraction. Looking forward, it explores a clear pathway to a post-capitalist economy. An economy that's more just, more caring, and more fun. An economy that enables human flourishing while reversing ecological breakdown. An economy that will not only lift us out of our current crisis, but restore our sense of connection to a world that's brimming with life. By taking less, we can become more.
